form:FormGroup.label: Row Match Expression
form:FormGroup.helpText: All rows matching this expression are formatted according to this rule's settings.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Rows matching this expression get this rule's formatting.

form:FormGroup.label: Enabled
form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick to enable this rule. When unticked, this rule is ignored.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, this rule is ignored.

form:FormGroup.label: Hide Matching Rows
form:FormGroup.helpText: When ticked, rows matching this rule are not shown in the table.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When ticked, matching rows are not shown.

form:FormGroup.label: Formatting Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the style is applied to matching rows: Background colours the row background, Text colours the text only, and Custom uses your own colours.

form:FormGroup.label: Style
form:FormGroup.helpText: Standard colour style to apply to matching rows.

form:FormGroup.label: Custom Style
form:FormGroup.helpText: Opens a dialog to set your own background and text colours for matching rows, for both light and dark themes.

form:FormGroup.label: Make Text Bold
form:FormGroup.helpText: When ticked, the text of matching rows is shown in bold.

form:FormGroup.label: Make Text Italic
form:FormGroup.helpText: When ticked, the text of matching rows is shown in italics.

form:FormGroup.label: Example
form:FormGroup.helpText: Preview of how matching rows will look with the chosen style.
